title: WRCC2023_MI_C: Three-class motor imagery dataset from the World Robot Contest 2023 (MI-C)
description: Three-class motor imagery (left hand, right hand, feet) EEG dataset from the MI-C track of the 2023 World Robot Contest BCI competition. It contains recordings from 8 participants, including 2 stroke patients, with 90 cue-based trials each, acquired with a 59-channel EEG system at 1000 Hz. This BIDS release was produced via MOABB from the original Harvard Dataverse deposit.
methods_description: Cue-based, offline motor imagery paradigm with three classes (left hand, right hand, feet), 30 trials per class per subject. EEG was recorded with a Neuracle NeuSen W 64-channel wireless system (59 EEG channels used) at 1000 Hz, standard_1005 montage, 50 Hz line frequency. Each 4 s trial is exposed as a separate run.
